submission_boundary: Explicit human approval is required before any submit action.

platforms.login_strategy: Require user-controlled authenticated browser session. Do not store credentials in the workspace.
platforms.form_discovery_strategy: Use browser-assist artifacts only for page reading and field observation after the user opens the page.
platforms.artifact_upload_strategy: Prepare field mapping and candidate files; require user confirmation before any upload or submit step.
stop_conditions: Bot detection or JavaScript SPA prevents reliable field inspection.
Any submit, apply, send, entry, or final confirmation button is visible.
Terms, consent, or privacy confirmation appears.
allowed_actions: Open target URL under user supervision.
forbidden_actions: Do not upload files without explicit human approval.
notes: Use manual browser session handoff when account login is required.
Keep live-submission-adapter as dry-run unless explicit approval is received.

platforms.login_strategy: Use user-owned email client or explicit Gmail draft/send flow only when requested.
platforms.form_discovery_strategy: No browser form. Prepare email subject, body, attachments, and final review checklist.
platforms.artifact_upload_strategy: Attach files only in a draft unless the user explicitly asks to send.
stop_conditions: Recipient address is missing or ambiguous.
User has not approved final email content.
Any send action is requested without explicit confirmation.
allowed_actions: Create draft if user requests a draft.
forbidden_actions: Do not submit or send by default.
Do not attach wrong or unreviewed files.
Do not use stale resume artifacts.
Do not infer approval from test success.
notes: Use polished PDF first when a PDF attachment is expected.
Keep human visual review required before sending.

platforms.login_strategy: No stored credentials. Access only publicly available form pages.
platforms.form_discovery_strategy: Observe field labels and create a mapping; stop before upload or final confirmation.
platforms.artifact_upload_strategy: Recommend files for upload but require user action/approval for actual upload.
stop_conditions: Page content differs from saved form snapshot.
forbidden_actions: Do not upload files without explicit approval.
notes: Prefer dry-run field mapping over automated filling.
Use live-submission-adapter to preserve the no-submit boundary.

platforms.login_strategy: Treat as blocked until the user provides access details or a reachable URL.
platforms.form_discovery_strategy: Do not infer fields. Ask user to provide screenshot, form text, or manual field labels.
stop_conditions: Application deadline or job availability is unclear.
Any submit or final confirmation step is unreachable or cannot be verified safely.
forbidden_actions: Do not guess hidden form fields.
Do not submit or simulate submission.
notes: This is the safest default when form access is unreliable.
